variant.author: MidoriKami
variant.changelog:
Standalone version of VanillaPlus's "Additional Hotbars" feature, that allows you to add an unlimited number of custom native hotbars to your UI, with the ability to configure various conditions to show and hide these hotbars automatically.

"0% of this plugin’s code was developed with the help of an AI assistant—not even at the 'Copilot' level, as defined in the Dalamud AI Usage Policy. I directed the entire design of the plugin, handcrafted every pixel of the UI myself, architected every single line, wrote all the code by hand, rectified my own human errors, and personally developed and tested every feature in-game across endless caffeine-fueled sessions. Bleatbot can run all the checks it wants: you will find absolutely zero machine-generated slop here.

P.S. Any chaotic code logic or confusing comments you encounter are entirely the fault of my own organic, unassisted brain."

AI disclosure, written by AI.
variant.description: Create hotbars of any size, spacing, and keybinds, with functions to show and hide these bars dynamically.
variant.name: ExpandedHotbars
variant.punchline: Add and control an unlimited number of custom additional hotbars.
